# Naming Conventions

Before introducing names, read `../../../docs/skills/NAMING-CONVENTIONS.md` and follow the nearest established pattern in the codebase.

Preserve current file layout and public names unless the task requires a rename. Keep names descriptive and consistent with the TypeScript-first codebase.
